en: Bzzzt! A barrier of crackling electricity blocks the way.
Wahahaha! Welcome, welcome! I'm Wattson, Mauville's Gym Leader, and I've been powering this city for years!
You got through my barriers, did you? Then let's see if you can take a real jolt! Wahahahaha!
Wahahahaha! Fine, you win! You've got a spark in you, all right!
Here, take the Dynamo Badge. You've earned it fair and square.
{player} received the Dynamo Badge from Wattson!
With the Dynamo Badge, your Pokémon can use Rock Smash outside of battle to break cracked rocks.
And this! It's a move I'm especially proud of.
TM34 holds Shock Wave. It strikes like lightning and never misses. Wahahaha!
Oh, and let's swap numbers! I like to keep up with bright young trainers.
TM34 holds Shock Wave. It strikes like lightning and never misses. Wahahaha!
Wahahaha! Keep that spark of yours burning bright, and you'll go far!
Hey, champ in the making! Wattson's barriers flip whenever you step on a switch on the floor.
His Pokémon are Electric types. Ground moves will hit them hard, and they can't shock you back!
You beat Wattson! The barriers are switched off for good now. What a shocking performance!
